subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers clear the conflicting fork candidate and queue a fresh narrow Feishu repair, or adopt and narrow the fork work by hand?
rationale: The source-level defect and fix boundary are clear, but an open fork PR still claims this issue while the same head was already closed in the target repo as broad and unmergeable.

options.title: Clear fork and queue fresh repair
options.body: Treat the conflicting fork branch as non-viable for landing and allow a new Feishu-only repair PR with tests and real quoted-message proof.

options.title: Adopt and narrow the fork
options.body: Use only the fetched-message mention-normalization idea from the fork and discard unrelated changes before review.

options.title: Leave owner-driven
options.body: Keep the issue open for Feishu owners to implement when they can provide live workspace proof.

recommendation.title: Clear fork and queue fresh repair
recommendation.body: Treat the conflicting fork branch as non-viable for landing and allow a new Feishu-only repair PR with tests and real quoted-message proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent Feishu mention/send-path history and public review activity on adjacent Feishu mention fixes.
